assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary (PROV-SITE-001) is a provisional rough boundary derived from the repository provisional_boundaries.geojson; its area and all derived ratios are provisional and must be recomputed after official SITE_BOUNDARY is published.
assumptions.impact: site_area_sqm and all area-relative metrics are provisional; replacing the boundary requires re-running scaffold, self-check, figures, and HTML.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons (PROV-KEY-001/002/003) are provisional and not official redlines; their extents, key_area_count, and related scenario locations are provisional.
assumptions.impact: Key-area detailed design, scenario placement, and landmark siting are concept suggestions pending official key-area geometry.

assumptions.statement: Floor area ratio, building height, building density, setbacks, road redlines, and facility standards are unknown because no official regulatory-plan conditions are available.
assumptions.impact: All intensity and control metrics use status=unknown and are excluded from formal scoring evidence; they become computable only after official conditions.

assumptions.statement: Building retain/renovate/demolish classification and ground-floor tenancy depend on ownership, existing-condition survey, and campus boundaries that are not yet provided.
assumptions.impact: Renewal project list and building-scale conclusions are concept suggestions; JZ-03/JZ-04 carry ownership-uncertainty risk.

assumptions.statement: Pipeline, energy, drainage, flood-control, and fire-engineering data for the overall-design scope are missing and listed as formal deepening prerequisites.
assumptions.impact: Transport/municipal proposals (section 8) and JZ-04/JZ-05 carry municipal-engineering risk and cannot be treated as engineering conclusions.

assumptions.statement: The heritage constraint (CONSTRAINT-HERITAGE, Qinghuayuan Station and railway corridor) and the rail constraint (CONSTRAINT-RAIL) actively bound any intervention, display, or public-space move.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks, heritage-park slow-mobility moves, and the edge-compute node must respect heritage and rail buffers; proposals are concept suggestions, not engineering or conservation conclusions.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenarios use aggregated or anonymous data only, with edge processing and no individual trajectory or face recognition; personal profiling for commercial recommendation is prohibited.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards, test-validation scenarios, and the accessibility design operate under data-minimization and human-review boundaries; this is a governance principle, not a verified system.

assumptions.statement: The five-to-eight global AI ecosystem cases (section 3.3) are drawn from publicly documented city/national AI programs and are used only as transferable-mechanism analogies; no investment, output, or enterprise figures are cited.
assumptions.impact: Cases are background mechanism references, not formal evidence or recruitment/funding commitments for this project.
